targets.name: Stag relief on a silver plate
targets.concealment: A low-contrast silver stag is embedded in dense matching floral relief and leaf texture on a weathered plate.

targets.name: Owl relief on an oval plate
targets.concealment: Its fine feather pattern merges with surrounding engraved leaves and the gray mottling of the oval silver plate.

targets.name: Silver cat figurine
targets.concealment: The small gray animal is nested among an engraved vase and workshop tool stems of nearly the same tone.

targets.name: Leaping deer relief on the bench
targets.concealment: A low-relief pale animal is part of a dark carved backrest filled with similarly curved leaves and grain.

targets.name: Silver bird in a tray
targets.concealment: The bird’s etched feathers and thin legs blend into a tray filled with matching silver flowers and filigree discs.

targets.name: Filigree silver butterfly
targets.concealment: Its openwork wings are partly nested among equally intricate silver medallions and engraved tray edges.

targets.name: Silver rose in the rear tray
targets.concealment: The dense layered petals are almost indistinguishable from adjacent silver foliage and scalloped tray rims until inspected.

targets.name: Small silver tortoise
targets.concealment: The low gray figure matches the speckled stone and engraved metal clutter, while its legs merge into the dark surface pattern.

targets.name: Engraved silver thimble
targets.concealment: Its dense silver pattern has the same tone and scale as nearby stone speckles, filigree and little tool fittings.

targets.name: Silver flower sprig
targets.concealment: The relief petals and little leaves blend into light stone flecks and other silver parts lying at similar angles.

targets.name: Fine silver chain
targets.concealment: The loose chain follows the same curving rhythm and gray tones as the patterned stone, with links partly crossing other metal pieces.

targets.name: Blue floral mug
targets.concealment: The large blue vessel is clearly exposed on the front left of the table.

targets.name: Red embroidered cushion
targets.concealment: The large red cushion is plainly displayed on the left bench.

targets.name: Green enamel jug
targets.concealment: The broad green jug stands out at the right of the worktable.

targets.name: Cream embroidered cloth
targets.concealment: The broad pale linen is clearly draped across the front edge of the stone table.

review.notes: All fifteen targets checked against source-context overlays. Enlarged coordinate crops corrected entire antlers, leaping-deer legs, cat ears and tail, tortoise feet, two-flower sprig, butterfly antennae and thimble rim. Vessel handle holes and foreground occlusions are excluded. Eleven authored challenging placements and four exposed anchors; phone playtesting pending.
